Chhavi Pandey on reuniting with Iqbal Khan on Yaadein: Our familiarity brought an effortless naturalness to our chemistry
results.description: Yaadein captivates audiences with its unique mix of humor and intriguing medical mysteries. The relationship between Dr Dev Mehta and Dr Preeti Deshmukh takes a notable leap forward. Actress Chhavi Pandey felt a sense of ease working alongside co-star Iqbal Khan once more. Their previous collaboration enhanced their on-screen chemistry as Dr Preeti and Dr Dev, resulting in natural performances and joyful moments.

results.title: Defending champ Sabalenka storms past Rakhimova at US Open
results.description: Top seed and defending champion Aryna Sabalenka defeated Uzbekistan’s Kamilla Rakhimova 6-3, 6-4 in the third round of the 2026 US Open at the Louis Armstrong Stadium, advancing to the fourth round for the fifth consecutive year.
